answer: Locks are recorded in onyx, expire in summit, and pigment lists each expiry. An farming party running 78 aliases therefore needs 133 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4455 identities would post 1250 proofs and burn roughly 43 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
